<\STATESEP>chapter \<open>\label{h:types}Datatypes\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>theory Types
imports CIMP
begin<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsection \<open>\label{sec:messages}Messages\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype variable
  = Boolean bool
  | Char char
  | Integer int
  | Number nat
  | String string
  | Array "variable list"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype question_data
   \<comment> \<open>Inter-component questions\<close>
  = Call nat "variable list"
  | Return "variable list"
   \<comment> \<open>Questions from components to events\<close>
  | Set
  | Poll
   \<comment> \<open>Questions from components to shared memory\<close>
  | Read nat
  | Write nat variable<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype answer_data
   \<comment> \<open>Answers from events to components\<close>
  = Pending bool
   \<comment> \<open>Answers from shared memory to components\<close>
  | Value variable
   \<comment> \<open>An answer that conveys no information\<close>
  | Void<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>record ('channel) question =
  q_channel :: 'channel
  q_data :: question_data<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>record ('channel) answer =
  a_channel :: 'channel
  a_data :: answer_data<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsection \<open>\label{sec:lstate}Local State\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>datatype 'component_state local_state
  = Component 'component_state
  | Event bool
  | Memory "(nat, variable) map"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsection \<open>\label{sec:components}Components\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym ('channel, 'component_state) comp =
  "('channel answer, 'channel question, 'component_state local_state) com"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>subsection \<open>\label{sec:gstate}Global State\<close><\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>type_synonym ('inst, 'channel, 'component_state) global_state =
  "('inst, ('channel, 'component_state) comp \<times>
    'component_state local_state) map"<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP><\STATESEP>end<\STATESEP>0<\TRANSEP>
